summary.text: Trey Stewart (listed on Ballotpedia as Harold Stewart, also known as Trey) is a Republican state senator from Presque Isle, Maine, who has represented Senate District 2 since December 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He served in the Maine House from 2016 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Stewart was born and lives in Presque Isle, Maine, and graduated from Presque Isle High School in 2012.
He earned an undergraduate degree in political science and sociology from the University of Maine in 2016 and an M.B.A. from the University of Maine in 2018.
His career experience includes working in the office of former U.S. Congressman Bruce Poliquin, for the Aroostook Partnership, and with the Northern Maine Development Commission.
Stewart represented Maine House District 147 from 2016 to 2020 and assumed office in the Maine State Senate on December 1, 2020, succeeding Michael Carpenter.
He was elected Senate minority leader in November 2022.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Conduct and Ethics Committee and the Senate Rules Committee, and he advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
